description: This PHP class 'AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams' extends FilterParams and encapsulates search filter parameters for attendance records, including employee numbers and date range filters. It also sets default sort field and order during instantiation.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Defines filter parameters for searching attendance records, including employee numbers and date range, with default sorting settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employee numbers filter criteria.
